title: Aarne-Thompson-Uther — Top-Level Tale-Type Categories
source: Hans-Jörg Uther, The Types of International Folktales (2004)
license: system/idea (the 7 top categories + number ranges); Uther's 2004 type descriptions are copyright and NOT reproduced — the per-type table comes from the CC-BY-SA `trilogy`/Bag-of-Tales datasets at fetch time
tier_note: Macro-tier genre skeleton: the 7 top groupings and their type-number ranges. Individual types (e.g. ATU 300 'The Dragon-Slayer') become plot-template presets, loaded later from the open derived datasets.

items.name: Animal Tales
items.description: Tales in which animals are the principal actors (wild animals, the fox, birds, fish, domestic animals).

items.name: Tales of Magic
items.description: Wonder tales / fairy tales: supernatural adversaries, helpers, tasks, and objects. The heart of the magic-tale corpus.

items.name: Religious Tales
items.description: Tales of God, saints, the afterworld, and the truth of religious belief.

items.name: Realistic Tales (Novelle)
items.description: Romantic and realistic tales won by cleverness, fidelity, or fortune, without the supernatural.

items.name: Tales of the Stupid Ogre (Giant, Devil)
items.description: A dull-witted ogre, giant, or devil is outwitted by a clever protagonist.

items.name: Anecdotes and Jokes
items.description: Humorous tales of fools, married couples, professions, and tall tales.

items.name: Formula Tales
items.description: Cumulative, chain, catch, and endless tales built on repeated structure.
